question: Should LINE retain `after_receive_record` by default while an opt-in `after_agent_dispatch` policy is implemented on the canonical per-event reply-lane result?
rationale: Choosing the permanent ACK default and Plugin SDK settlement boundary affects upgrades, other webhook channels, message-loss behavior, and the public plugin contract; line-level repair cannot safely choose that direction.

options.title: Preserve default, add canonical opt-in
options.body: Keep the shipped policy as default and stack an explicit dispatch-acceptance policy on the core result tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/108411.

options.title: Migrate the default after core work
options.body: Finish the canonical result first, then intentionally change the default with upgrade documentation and proof for existing installations.

options.title: Accept the LINE-local contract
options.body: Merge the current channel-specific inference while explicitly accepting its remaining false-ack and API-drift risks.

recommendation.title: Preserve default, add canonical opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep the shipped policy as default and stack an explicit dispatch-acceptance policy on the core result tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/108411.
